checks.title: Validate the left-side Jarvis interaction-mode selector
checks.instructions: After machine QA is clean, open the real Control Center and switch between SIMPLE and PRESENTATION, inspect keyboard/focus behavior, and inspect the REUNION option. Confirm the control does not overlap Bare Hands, Scene, notifications, or critical status controls.
checks.expected: SIMPLE and PRESENTATION are understandable and authoritative; REUNION is visibly reserved/unavailable; keyboard/focus interaction is usable and layout remains clear.
